articles.title: Bitcoin risk management grows more popular as the 'just bet on price' era fades
JPMorgan Puts a Number on Bitcoin for the First Time: 10% a Year, With a Big Caveat
articles.snippet: J.P. Morgan Asset Management’s 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions project a 10% annual return for Bitcoin over 10 to 15 years, though the firm isn’t adding it to its main portfolio models.

articles.title: BlackRock Files for 'Buffer' Bitcoin ETF as IBIT Draws $665M in a Day
articles.snippet: The iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF would use options on IBIT to limit losses, in exchange for giving up some upside.
